# Data

```{r message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# Load necessary libraries
library(tidyverse)
library(lubridate)

# Load the data
df <- read.csv("data/IGO_full_data_1.csv")

# Print the shape of the DataFrame
cat("Shape of the DataFrame:", dim(df)[1], "rows and", dim(df)[2], "columns\n")
```

## Data Prep

```{r}
# ==== Create mandate breadth score ====
library(dplyr)

# Calculate tercile cutoffs
quantiles <- quantile(df$mandate_breadth, probs = c(1/3, 2/3), na.rm = TRUE)

# Create categorical variable with descriptive labels
df <- df %>%
  mutate(
    Mandate_Breadth_Cat = case_when(
      mandate_breadth <= quantiles[1] ~ "Low Mandate Breadth",
      mandate_breadth <= quantiles[2] ~ "Medium Mandate Breadth",
      mandate_breadth >  quantiles[2] ~ "High Mandate Breadth",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    )
  )

# ==== Create endurance category score ====
library(dplyr)

# Define cutoffs
low_mod_cut <- 0.3664222
mod_high_cut <- 0.4982493

# Create endurance category variable
df <- df %>%
  mutate(
    Endurance_Category = case_when(
      endurance_score <= low_mod_cut ~ "Weak Endurance",
      endurance_score <= mod_high_cut ~ "Moderate Endurance",
      endurance_score >  mod_high_cut ~ "Strong Endurance",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    )
  )

```

#### Specialisation

```{r}
library(dplyr)

# Define thresholds
low_med_cutoff <- 0.33
med_high_cutoff <- 0.66

# Apply categorization
df <- df %>%
  mutate(
    Specialisation_Level = case_when(
      niche_specialisation <= low_med_cutoff ~ "Broad Mandate",
      niche_specialisation <= med_high_cutoff ~ "Mixed Mandate",
      niche_specialisation >  med_high_cutoff ~ "Narrow Mandate",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    )
  )

```

```{r}
library(dplyr)

# ==== Define cutoffs ====
# For 0–10 scale
low_med_cutoff_10 <- 3.33
med_high_cutoff_10 <- 6.66

# ==== Apply categorization ====
df <- df %>%
  mutate(
    # Strategy diversification category
    Strategy_Diversification_Category = case_when(
      strategy_diversification <= low_med_cutoff_10 ~ "Low Diversified Strategies",
      strategy_diversification <= med_high_cutoff_10 ~ "Moderate Diversified Strategies",
      strategy_diversification >  med_high_cutoff_10 ~ "High Diversified Strategies",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),
    
    # Objective diversification category
    Objective_Diversification_Category = case_when(
      objective_diversification <= low_med_cutoff_10 ~ "Low Diversified Objectives",
      objective_diversification <= med_high_cutoff_10 ~ "Moderate Diversified Objectives",
      objective_diversification >  med_high_cutoff_10 ~ "High Diversified Objectives",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    )
  )

```

```{r}
# Convert to long format for dimension-based plotting

  select(institution, Mandate_Breadth_Cat,
```

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(stringr)
library(tidyr)

# Helper function to clean up element names
pretty_element <- function(x) {
  x %>%
    str_remove("_within_igo$") %>%
    str_replace_all("_", " ") %>%
    str_to_title()
}

# Generalized function to count elements
count_elements <- function(df, cols, category) {
  if (length(cols) == 0) return(tibble())
  df %>%
    select(institution, all_of(cols)) %>%
    pivot_longer(cols = -institution, names_to = "Element", values_to = "Value") %>%
    filter(!is.na(Value), Value > 0) %>%
    group_by(Element) %>%
    summarise(Count = n_distinct(institution), .groups = "drop") %>%
    mutate(
      Element = pretty_element(Element),
      Dimension = category
    )
}

# Count elements for each dimension
sources_count <- count_elements(hh_igos, sources_cols, "Sources")
spatial_count <- count_elements(hh_igos, spatial_cols, "Spatial")
subject_count <- count_elements(hh_igos, subject_cols, "Subject-Matter")

# Combine all counts
all_counts <- bind_rows(sources_count, spatial_count, subject_count)

# ==== Unified Plot ====
ggplot(all_counts, aes(x = reorder(Element, Count), y = Count, fill = Dimension)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.7) +
  geom_text(aes(label = Count), hjust = -0.1, size = 3.2) +
  coord_flip() +
  facet_wrap(~ Dimension, scales = "free_y", ncol = 1) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(
    "Sources" = "#1b9e77",
    "Spatial" = "#d95f02",
    "Subject-Matter" = "#7570b3"
  )) +
  expand_limits(y = max(all_counts$Count, na.rm = TRUE) * 1.1) +
  labs(
    title = "Figure 1.2E — Jurisdictional Coverage Among High-Endurance IGOs",
    subtitle = "Count of IGOs engaging each element across sources, spatial reach, and subject areas",
    x = NULL,
    y = "Number of IGOs"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.position = "none",
        strip.text = element_text(face = "bold"),
        panel.grid.major.y = element_blank())

```

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(stringr)
library(tidyr)
library(forcats)
library(patchwork)  # for layout control

# --- Helper to clean names ---
pretty_element <- function(x) {
  x %>%
    str_remove("_within_igo$") %>%
    str_replace_all("_", " ") %>%
    str_to_title()
}

# --- Count elements ---
count_elements <- function(df, cols, category) {
  if (length(cols) == 0) return(tibble())
  df %>%
    select(institution, all_of(cols)) %>%
    pivot_longer(cols = -institution, names_to = "Element", values_to = "Value") %>%
    filter(!is.na(Value), Value > 0) %>%
    group_by(Element) %>%
    summarise(Count = n_distinct(institution), .groups = "drop") %>%
    mutate(
      Element = pretty_element(Element),
      Dimension = category
    )
}

# --- Count across dimensions ---
sources_count <- count_elements(hh_igos, sources_cols, "Sources")
spatial_count <- count_elements(hh_igos, spatial_cols, "Spatial")
subject_count <- count_elements(hh_igos, subject_cols, "Subject-Matter")

# --- Reorder elements within each dimension ---
sources_count <- sources_count %>% mutate(Element = fct_reorder(Element, Count))
spatial_count <- spatial_count %>% mutate(Element = fct_reorder(Element, Count))
subject_count <- subject_count %>% mutate(Element = fct_reorder(Element, Count))

# === Plot function (no count labels) ===
plot_dim <- function(data, title, fill_color) {
  ggplot(data, aes(x = Element, y = Count)) +
    geom_col(fill = fill_color, width = 0.7) +
    coord_flip() +
    expand_limits(y = max(data$Count) * 1.1) +
    labs(title = title, x = NULL, y = "Number of IGOs") +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(
      panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),
      plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 13)
    )
}

# === Generate individual plots ===
p_sources <- plot_dim(sources_count, "Leagl", "#1b9e77")
p_spatial <- plot_dim(spatial_count, "Spatial", "#d95f02")
p_subject <- plot_dim(subject_count, "Subject-Matter", "#7570b3")

# === Combine plots using patchwork ===
combined_plot <- (p_sources | p_spatial) / p_subject +
  plot_annotation(
    title = "Figure 1.2d Jurisdictional and Legal Authority Among High-Endurance IGOs",
    subtitle = "Number of IGOs engaging each element across mandate dimensions",
    theme = theme(
      plot.title = element_text(size = 14),
      plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 12, margin = margin(b = 10))
    )
  )

# === Display the plot ===
combined_plot

```

```{r}
# ==== Load required libraries ====
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggrepel)

# ==== Create Mandate Breadth Categories ====
# Calculate terciles (quantiles at 1/3 and 2/3)
quantiles <- quantile(df$mandate_breadth, probs = c(1/3, 2/3), na.rm = TRUE)

# Assign category based on terciles
df <- df %>%
  mutate(
    Mandate_Breadth_Cat = case_when(
      mandate_breadth <= quantiles[1] ~ "Low Mandate Breadth",
      mandate_breadth <= quantiles[2] ~ "Medium Mandate Breadth",
      mandate_breadth >  quantiles[2] ~ "High Mandate Breadth",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    )
  )

# Ensure the factor order is meaningful
df$Mandate_Breadth_Cat <- factor(
  df$Mandate_Breadth_Cat,
  levels = c("Low Mandate Breadth", "Medium Mandate Breadth", "High Mandate Breadth")
)

# ==== Create Plot ====
# Optional: Highlight top 5% most enduring IGOs
top_enduring <- df %>%
  filter(endurance_score >= quantile(endurance_score, 0.95, na.rm = TRUE))

# Build the plot
p_combined <- ggplot(df, aes(x = mandate_breadth, y = endurance_score, color = Mandate_Breadth_Cat)) +
  geom_point(size = 3, alpha = 0.8) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = FALSE, linetype = "dotted", linewidth = 0.8) +
  geom_text_repel(
    data = top_enduring,
    aes(label = institution),
    size = 3.5,
    max.overlaps = 12,
    segment.color = "grey60"
  ) +
  facet_wrap(~ Mandate_Breadth_Cat, nrow = 1) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c(
    "Low Mandate Breadth" = "firebrick",
    "Medium Mandate Breadth" = "steelblue",
    "High Mandate Breadth" = "forestgreen"
  )) +
  labs(
    title = "Figure 1.2B — Mandate Breadth and IGO Endurance by Category",
    subtitle = "Each panel shows IGOs grouped by mandate breadth; dotted line = linear trend",
    x = "Mandate Breadth Score",
    y = "IGO Endurance (EEI)",
    color = "Mandate Category"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.position = "none")

# ==== Display the plot ====
print(p_combined)

```

```{r}
# Helper function to reshape and count
prepare_plot_data <- function(data, cols, dimension_name) {
  data |>
    select(institution, any_of(cols)) |>
    pivot_longer(-institution, names_to = "category", values_to = "present") |>
    filter(!is.na(present), present > 0) |>
    mutate(
      type = if_else(str_detect(category, "withinigo$"), "WithinIGO", "AcrossIGO"),
      category_clean = category |>
        str_remove("_withinigo|_acrossigo") |>
        str_replace_all("_", " ") |>
        str_to_title(),
      dimension = dimension_name
    ) |>
    group_by(dimension, type, category_clean) |>
    summarise(n_igos = n(), .groups = "drop") |>
    group_by(dimension) |>
    mutate(category_clean = fct_reorder(category_clean, n_igos)) |>
    ungroup()
}
```

```{r}
# === Helper function to prepare data for plotting ===

prepare_plot_data <- function(data, cols, dimension_name) {
  data |>
    select(institution, any_of(cols)) |>
    pivot_longer(-institution, names_to = "category", values_to = "present") |>
    filter(!is.na(present), present > 0) |>
    mutate(
      type = if_else(str_detect(category, "withinigo$"), "WithinIGO", "AcrossIGO"),
      category_clean = category |>
        str_remove("_withinigo|_acrossigo") |>
        str_replace_all("_", " ") |>
        str_to_title(),
      dimension = dimension_name
    ) |>
    group_by(dimension, type, category_clean) |>
    summarise(n_igos = n(), .groups = "drop") |>
    group_by(dimension) |>
    mutate(category_clean = fct_reorder(category_clean, n_igos)) |>
    ungroup()
}

# === Combine all dimensions and set facet order ===

plot_all <- bind_rows(
  prepare_plot_data(high_endurance_igos, spatial_cols, "Spatial Jurisdiction"),
  prepare_plot_data(high_endurance_igos, sources_cols, "Sources of Jurisdiction"),
  prepare_plot_data(high_endurance_igos, subject_cols, "Subject Matter")
) |>
  mutate(dimension = factor(dimension, levels = c(
    "Spatial Jurisdiction",
    "Sources of Jurisdiction",
    "Subject Matter"
  )))

# === Grouped bar plot ===

grouped_bar_plot <- ggplot(plot_all, aes(x = n_igos, y = fct_rev(category_clean), fill = type)) +
  geom_col(position = "dodge") +
  facet_wrap(~ dimension, scales = "free_y", ncol = 1) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c("WithinIGO" = "#1f77b4", "AcrossIGO" = "#ff7f0e"),
    name = "Coverage Type"
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Figure 1.2d Jurisdictional and Legal Authority Among High-Endurance IGOs",
    subtitle = "Grouped bar chart of IGO engagement across mandate dimensions and coverage type",
    x = "Number of IGOs",
    y = "Jurisdictional Element"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 12),
    legend.position = "top"
  )

# === Display the plot ===
grouped_bar_plot
```

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(tidyr)

# Combine both coordination types into one long format
df_long <- df %>%
  select(Vertical_Coordination, Horizontal_Coordination, Endurance_Category) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(Vertical_Coordination, Horizontal_Coordination),
    names_to = "Coordination_Type",
    values_to = "Coordination_Level"
  )

# Count occurrences
df_count <- df_long %>%
  count(Coordination_Type, Coordination_Level, Endurance_Category)

# Unified plot with facets
ggplot(df_count, aes(x = Coordination_Level, y = n, fill = Endurance_Category)) +
  geom_col(position = "dodge") +
  facet_wrap(~ Coordination_Type, scales = "free_x") +
  labs(
    title = "Distribution of IGOs by Coordination Type and Endurance",
    x = "Coordination Level",
    y = "Number of IGOs",
```

```{r message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# Plot

  # Smoothed trend lines

  # Facet by coordination type
  facet_wrap(~ Coordination_Type, scales = "free_x") +
  # Titles and labels
  labs(
    title = "Figure 1.3a High-Endurance Institutions by Coordination Score",

    color = "Coordination Type"

  # Theme styling

  theme(

    panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
  ) +
  scale_color_manual(values = coord_colors)
```

```{r}
  "reporting_compliance_mechanisms_acrossigo", "sectoral_to_national_coordination_acrossigo",
  "technical_assistance_to_states_acrossigo", "un_to_member_states_acrossigo"
)

horizontal_cols <- c(
  "advocacy_and_communication_withinigo", "cross_border_initiatives_withinigo",
  "cross_sectoral_collaboration_withinigo", "inter_agency_technical_cooperation_withinigo",
  "joint_research_and_projects_withinigo", "multi_stakeholder_platforms_withinigo",
  "peer_to_peer_learning_mechanisms_withinigo", "regional_economic_community_coordination_withinigo",
  "shared_monitoring_frameworks_withinigo", "thematic_working_groups_withinigo",
  "advocacy_and_communication_acrossigo", "cross_border_initiatives_acrossigo",
  "cross_sectoral_collaboration_acrossigo", "inter_agency_technical_cooperation_acrossigo",
  "joint_research_and_projects_acrossigo", "multi_stakeholder_platforms_acrossigo",
  "peer_to_peer_learning_mechanisms_acrossigo", "regional_economic_community_coordination_acrossigo",
  "shared_monitoring_frameworks_acrossigo", "thematic_working_groups_acrossigo"
)

# Helper function to reshape and count
prepare_plot_data <- function(data, cols, dimension_name) {
  data |>
    select(institution, all_of(cols)) |>
    pivot_longer(-institution, names_to = "category", values_to = "present") |>
    filter(!is.na(present), present > 0) |>
    mutate(
      type = if_else(str_detect(category, "withinigo$"), "WithinIGO", "AcrossIGO"),
      category_clean = category |>
        str_remove("_withinigo|_acrossigo") |>
        str_replace_all("_", " ") |>
        str_to_title(),
      dimension = dimension_name
    ) |>
    group_by(dimension, type, category_clean) |>
    summarise(n_igos = n(), .groups = "drop") |>
    group_by(dimension) |>
    mutate(category_clean = fct_reorder(category_clean, n_igos)) |>
    ungroup()
}

# Combine vertical and horizontal coordination mechanisms

  prepare_plot_data(high_endurance_igos, vertical_cols, "Vertical Coordination"),
  prepare_plot_data(high_endurance_igos, horizontal_cols, "Horizontal Coordination")
) |>
  mutate(dimension = factor(dimension, levels = c("Vertical Coordination", "Horizontal Coordination")))


ggplot(coordination_plot_data, aes(x = n_igos, y = fct_rev(category_clean), fill = n_igos)) +
```

```{r}
# Helper function to reshape and count
prepare_plot_data <- function(data, cols, dimension_name) {
  data |>
    select(institution, all_of(cols)) |>
```

```{r}
y_max <- max(df$endurance_score, na.rm = TRUE)

# Plot
ggplot(df, aes(x = strategy_diversification , y = endurance_score)) +
  # Background bands
  geom_rect(aes(xmin = -Inf, xmax = Inf, ymin = y_min, ymax = low_mod_cut),
            fill = "#FEE0D2", alpha = 0.5) +  # Weak
  geom_rect(aes(xmin = -Inf, xmax = Inf, ymin = low_mod_cut, ymax = mod_high_cut),
            fill = "#FFF7BC", alpha = 0.5) +  # Moderate
  geom_rect(aes(xmin = -Inf, xmax = Inf, ymin = mod_high_cut, ymax = y_max),
            fill = "#D9F0A3", alpha = 0.5) +  # Strong

  # Category labels
  annotate("text", x = 1, y = (y_min + low_mod_cut)/2, label = "Weak", hjust = 0, size = 5, fontface = "bold") +
  annotate("text", x = 1, y = (low_mod_cut + mod_high_cut)/2, label = "Moderate", hjust = 0, size = 5, fontface = "bold") +
  annotate("text", x = 1, y = (mod_high_cut + y_max)/2, label = "Strong", hjust = 0, size = 5, fontface = "bold") +

  # Data points and regression line
  geom_point(color = "steelblue", size = 3, alpha = 0.7) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = TRUE, color = "darkblue", linewidth = 1) +

  # Label only IGOs in the "Strong" category
  geom_text_repel(
    data = subset(df, endurance_score > mod_high_cut),
    aes(label = institution),
    size = 3,
    max.overlaps = Inf,
    color = "black"
  ) +

  # Labels and theme
  labs(
    title = "Figure 1.2a Relationship Between strategy diversification  and Endurance",
    subtitle = "Endurance categorized as Weak, Moderate, and Strong",
    x = "Mandate Breadth (Scaled 0–10)",
    y = "Endurance Score"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```

```{r}
library(tidyverse)

# === 1. Define the spatial and subject columns ===
spatial_columns <- c(
  "archipelago_withinigo", "coastal_zone_withinigo", "contiguous_zone_cz_withinigo",
  "enclosed_or_semi_enclosed_sea_withinigo", "exclusive_economic_zone_eez_withinigo",
  "extended_continental_shelf_cs_withinigo", "high_seas_withinigo", "internal_waters_withinigo",
  "territorial_sea_ts_withinigo", "the_area_withinigo",
  "archipelago_acrossigo", "coastal_zone_acrossigo", "contiguous_zone_cz_acrossigo",
  "enclosed_or_semi_enclosed_sea_acrossigo", "exclusive_economic_zone_eez_acrossigo",
  "extended_continental_shelf_cs_acrossigo", "high_seas_acrossigo", "internal_waters_acrossigo",
  "territorial_sea_ts_acrossigo", "the_area_acrossigo"
)

subject_columns <- c(
  "biodiversity_ecosystem_conservation_withinigo",
  "cultural_heritage_traditional_knowledge_data_governance_withinigo",
  "disaster_risk_reduction_resilience_withinigo",
  "environmental_protection_climate_change_withinigo",
  "human_rights_social_justice_advocacy_withinigo",
  "international_cooperation_governance_withinigo",
  "research_science_innovation_withinigo",
  "security_safety_withinigo",
  "sustainable_development_capacity_building_withinigo",
  "trade_investment_economic_cooperation_withinigo",
  "biodiversity_ecosystem_conservation_acrossigo",
  "cultural_heritage_traditional_knowledge_data_governance_acrossigo",
  "disaster_risk_reduction_resilience_acrossigo",
  "environmental_protection_climate_change_acrossigo",
  "human_rights_social_justice_advocacy_acrossigo",
  "international_cooperation_governance_acrossigo",
  "research_science_innovation_acrossigo",
  "security_safety_acrossigo",
  "sustainable_development_capacity_building_acrossigo",
  "trade_investment_economic_cooperation_acrossigo"
)

# === 2. Improved Helper Function ===
prepare_engagement_data <- function(data, cols, dimension_name) {
  data %>%
    dplyr::select(institution, all_of(cols)) %>%
    pivot_longer(-institution, names_to = "category", values_to = "present") %>%
    filter(!is.na(present), present > 0) %>%
    mutate(
      category_type = if_else(str_detect(category, "_withinigo$"), "Within-IGO", "Across-IGO"),
      category_clean = category %>%
        str_remove("_withinigo|_acrossigo") %>%
        str_replace_all("_", " ") %>%
        str_to_title()
    ) %>%
    group_by(category_clean, category_type) %>%
    summarise(n_igos = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
    mutate(
      category_clean = fct_reorder(category_clean, n_igos),
      dimension = dimension_name
    )
}

# === 3. Prepare Data for Narrow IGOs Only ===
spatial_data <- prepare_engagement_data(narrow_df, spatial_columns, "Spatial")
subject_data <- prepare_engagement_data(narrow_df, subject_columns, "Subject")

# === 4. Plot: Spatial Domains (Figure 2.3a) ===
ggplot(spatial_data, aes(x = n_igos, y = fct_rev(category_clean), fill = category_type)) +
  geom_col(position = position_dodge(width = 0.7), width = 0.6) +
  geom_text(aes(label = n_igos), position = position_dodge(width = 0.7), hjust = -0.2, size = 3.2) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Within-IGO" = "#6A51A3", "Across-IGO" = "#BC80BD")) +
  scale_y_discrete(labels = function(x) str_wrap(x, width = 30)) +
  labs(
    title = "Figure 2.3a: Spatial Engagement Patterns",
    subtitle = "Among IGOs with Narrow Mandates",
    x = "Number of IGOs",
    y = "Spatial Domain",
    fill = "Engagement Type"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(size = 12, hjust = 0.5),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 10, hjust = 0.5),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 10),
    legend.position = "right"
  ) +
  coord_cartesian(clip = "off", expand = TRUE)

# === 5. Plot: Subject-Matter Domains (Figure 2.3b) ===
ggplot(subject_data, aes(x = n_igos, y = fct_rev(category_clean), fill = category_type)) +
  geom_col(position = position_dodge(width = 0.7), width = 0.6) +
  geom_text(aes(label = n_igos), position = position_dodge(width = 0.7), hjust = -0.2, size = 3.2) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Within-IGO" = "#1F78B4", "Across-IGO" = "#A6CEE3")) +
  scale_y_discrete(labels = function(x) str_wrap(x, width = 30)) +
  labs(
    title = "Figure 2.1b: Subject-Matter Engagement Patterns",
    subtitle = "Among IGOs with Narrow Mandates",
    x = "Number of IGOs",
    y = "Subject Matter",
    fill = "Engagement Type"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(size = 12, hjust = 0.5),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 10, hjust = 0.5),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 10),
    legend.position = "right"
  ) +
  coord_cartesian(clip = "off", expand = TRUE)
```

```{r}
# Load data
data <- subset_df

# Define subject and spatial columns
spatial_cols <- c("archipelago", "coastal_zone", "enclosed_or_semi_enclosed_sea", "high_seas", "internal_waters", "the_area")
subject_cols <- c(
  "biodiversity_ecosystem_conservation", "cultural_heritage_traditional_knowledge_data_governance",
  "disaster_risk_reduction_resilience", "environmental_protection_climate_change",
  "human_rights_social_justice_advocacy", "international_cooperation_governance",
  "research_science_innovation", "security_safety",
  "sustainable_development_capacity_building", "trade_investment_economic_cooperation"
)

# Compute subject–spatial intersection score
data$intersection_score <- apply(data, 1, function(row) {
  spatial <- as.numeric(row[spatial_cols])
  subject <- as.numeric(row[subject_cols])
  sum(outer(spatial, subject, "*"))  
})

```

```{r}
    size = "Niche Specialisation",

    plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 11),
    legend.position = "right",
    panel.grid.major = element_line(color = "grey90"),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
  )
```

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)

# --- STEP 1: Define your column groups ---
spatial_cols <- c("archipelago", "coastal_zone", "enclosed_or_semi_enclosed_sea", 
                  "high_seas", "internal_waters", "the_area")

subject_cols <- c("biodiversity_ecosystem_conservation", "cultural_heritage_traditional_knowledge_data_governance",
                  "disaster_risk_reduction_resilience", "environmental_protection_climate_change",
                  "human_rights_social_justice_advocacy", "international_cooperation_governance",
                  "research_science_innovation", "security_safety",
                  "sustainable_development_capacity_building", "trade_investment_economic_cooperation")

# --- STEP 2: Compute subject-spatial intersections matrix ---
intersection_matrix <- t(apply(data, 1, function(row) {
  spatial <- as.numeric(row[spatial_cols])
  subject <- as.numeric(row[subject_cols])
  as.vector(outer(spatial, subject, "*"))  # Outer product
}))

# Label columns
spatial_labels <- c("archipelago", "coastal", "enclosed", "high_seas", "internal", "the area")
subject_labels <- c("biodiversity_ecosystem_conservation", "culture", "disaster_risk_reduction_resilience", "environmental_protection_climate_change", "human_rights_social_justice_advocacy", "international_cooperation_governance",
                    "research_science_innovation", "security_safety", "sustainable_development_capacity_building", "trade_investment_economic_cooperation")

colnames(intersection_matrix) <- as.vector(outer(spatial_labels, subject_labels, paste, sep = "_"))
rownames(intersection_matrix) <- data$institution

# --- STEP 3: Convert to tidy format ---
intersection_df <- as.data.frame(intersection_matrix)
intersection_df$institution <- rownames(intersection_matrix)

long_df <- pivot_longer(intersection_df, 
                        cols = -institution, 
                        names_to = "intersection", 
                        values_to = "score")

# --- STEP 4: Aggregate by intersection ---
intersection_summary <- long_df %>%
  group_by(intersection) %>%
  summarise(avg_score = mean(score, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  arrange(desc(avg_score))

# --- STEP 5: Extract Top 10 and Bottom 10 ---
top_10 <- intersection_summary %>% top_n(15, avg_score)
bottom_10 <- intersection_summary %>% top_n(3, avg_score)

# --- STEP 6: Plot Top 10 ---
ggplot(top_10, aes(x = reorder(intersection, avg_score), y = avg_score)) +
  geom_col(fill = "#2a9d8f") +
  coord_flip() +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(title = "Top 10 Most Common Subject–Spatial Intersections",
       x = "Subject–Spatial Intersection",
       y = "Average Score Across IGOs")

# --- STEP 7: Plot Bottom 10 ---
ggplot(bottom_10, aes(x = reorder(intersection, avg_score), y = avg_score)) +
  geom_col(fill = "#e76f51") +
  coord_flip() +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(title = "Bottom 10 Least Common Subject–Spatial Intersections",
       x = "Subject–Spatial Intersection",
       y = "Average Score Across IGOs")

```

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(forcats)
library(ggalluvial)
library(stringr)  # for str_wrap

# Shorten labels for better readability
short_labels <- function(label) {
  label <- str_replace_all(label, "_", " ")
  str_wrap(label, width = 30)
}

top10 <- top10 %>%
  mutate(intersection = short_labels(intersection))

bottom10 <- bottom10 %>%
  mutate(intersection = short_labels(intersection))

# Plot Top 10
ggplot(top10, aes(x = fct_reorder(intersection, total_score), y = total_score, fill = total_score)) +
  geom_col(show.legend = FALSE) +
  coord_flip() +
  scale_fill_gradient(low = "#6baed6", high = "#08306b") +
  labs(title = "Figure 2.3a Top Subject–Spatial Intersections",
       x = NULL,
       y = "Total Score") +
  theme_light(base_size = 12) +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 14),
        axis.text.y = element_text(size = 10))

# Plot Bottom 10
ggplot(bottom10, aes(x = fct_reorder(intersection, total_score), y = total_score, fill = total_score)) +
  geom_col(show.legend = FALSE) +
  coord_flip() +
  scale_fill_gradient(low = "#fcbba1", high = "#cb181d") +
  labs(title = "Bottom 3 Least Common Subject–Spatial Intersections",
       x = NULL,
       y = "Total Score") +
  theme_light(base_size = 12) +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 14),
        axis.text.y = element_text(size = 10))

```

```{r}
library(ggplot2)

# Prepare data for heatmap
heatmap_data <- as.data.frame(intersection_matrix) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = everything(), names_to = "intersection", values_to = "score") %>%
  separate(intersection, into = c("Spatial", "Subject"), sep = " x ") %>%
  group_by(Spatial, Subject) %>%
  summarise(total_score = sum(score, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

# Plot
ggplot(heatmap_data, aes(x = Subject, y = Spatial, fill = total_score)) +
  geom_tile(color = "white") +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(option = "C", direction = -1) +
  labs(title = "Heatmap of Subject–Spatial Intersections",
       x = "Subject Domain",
       y = "Spatial Domain",
       fill = "Total Score") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))
```

```{r}
library(ggplot2)

library(tidyr)

# Split intersection into spatial and subject components
intersection_long_split <- intersection_long %>%
  separate(intersection, into = c("spatial", "subject"), sep = " x ") %>%
  mutate(spatial = str_replace_all(spatial, "_", " "),
         subject = str_replace_all(subject, "_", " "),
```

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(networkD3)
library(htmlwidgets)

# Prepare nodes
nodes <- data.frame(name = unique(c(intersection_long_split$spatial,
                                    intersection_long_split$subject)),
                    stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

# Create links
links <- intersection_long_split %>%
  mutate(source = match(spatial, nodes$name) - 1,
         target = match(subject, nodes$name) - 1,
         value = total_score) %>%
  select(source, target, value)

# Create Sankey diagram with increased height
sankey <- sankeyNetwork(Links = links,
                        Nodes = nodes,
                        Source = "source",
                        Target = "target",
                        Value = "value",
                        NodeID = "name",
                        fontSize = 12,
                        nodeWidth = 30,
                        sinksRight = FALSE,
                        height = 800)  # Increase height here

# Add title
sankey_with_title <- htmlwidgets::prependContent(
  sankey,
  htmltools::tags$h2("Subject–Spatial Intersections Across IGOs", style = "text-align:center; font-family:Arial; color:#2c3e50;")
)

# Display
sankey_with_title

```

```{r}
# Install if needed

library(networkD3)
library(dplyr)


# Create node list
spatial_nodes <- unique(intersection_long_split$spatial)
subject_nodes <- unique(intersection_long_split$subject)

nodes <- data.frame(name = c(spatial_nodes, subject_nodes))

# Create link list
links <- intersection_long_split %>%
  mutate(
    source = match(spatial, nodes$name) - 1,
    target = match(subject, nodes$name) - 1,
    value = total_score
  ) %>%
  select(source, target, value)

# Define colors
my_color <- 'd3.scaleOrdinal()
  .domain(["spatial", "subject"])
  .range(["#1f77b4", "#ff7f0e"])'

# Create Sankey plot
sankey <- sankeyNetwork(Links = links,
                        Nodes = nodes,
                        Source = "source",
                        Target = "target",
                        Value = "value",
                        NodeID = "name",
                        fontSize = 14,
                        nodeWidth = 30,
                        sinksRight = FALSE,
                        colourScale = my_color,
                        width = 1000,
                        height = 700)

# Display
sankey

# Save as HTML and convert to PNG using webshot
# install.packages("htmlwidgets")
# install.packages("webshot2")
library(htmlwidgets)
library(webshot2)

saveWidget(sankey, "sankey_plot.html", selfcontained = TRUE)
webshot("sankey_plot.html", "sankey_plot.png", vwidth = 1200, vheight = 800)
```
